'''Rim 3''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Kibilini sector/Legends|Kibilini sector]]. In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] visited Rim 3 while searching for the rogue [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] [[Abal Karda]].
